Across both papers, 97,151 candidates registered, of whom 84,731 appeared and 12,420 were absent. In total, 53,314 candidates qualified, with an overall pass percentage of 64.48%. Candidates can download their marks for the Odisha Teacher Eligibility Test by visiting the official website i.e., bseodisha.nic.in.  The BSE Odisha result PDF contains the qualifying status and marks achieved in each subject. Those who have cleared the exam will get the certificate, which will be valid for life. Aspirants can scroll this article to check the result direct link, steps to download, and other important details.

BSE Odisha OTET Result 2026 PDF Download Link @bseodisha.ac.in

Candidates who appeared in OTET 2026 Exam, can download the result directly from the official portal or through the direct link provided below. The BSE Odisha OTET result 2026 has been declared in the form of a scorecard. Candidates can download the result using their email or mobile number and password. Candidates must also note that just qualifying does not guarantee appointment; it makes candidates eligible for applying to teaching posts.

bseodisha.ac.in OTET Result 2026 Overview

OTET is a state-level exam to determine the eligibility of primary or upper primary teachers for classes 1 through 8 in government and private schools across Odisha. The overview of the BSE Odisha OTET Result and OTET Exam is given in the table below:

Exam Name Odisha Teacher Eligibility Test (OTET) 2026

BSE Odisha Result OUT 2026

Candidates should go to the official website i.e, bseodisha.ac.in in order to download the BSE Odisha OTET Result and get updates directly. The official website hosts the result portal where aspirants can enter required details like mobile number and password to view and download their scorecard PDFs. It also provides notifications for future recruitment processes and certificates.

OTET Result 2026 Statistics

BSE Odisha OTET Result is announced, mentioning the number of qualified and unqualified candidates in the exam. The passing marks in Paper 1 are 68.28% and 60.68% Paper 2. Paper 2 had a much larger number of candidates appearing for the exam. The detailed statistics for OTET Paper 1 and OTET Paper 2 are provided in the table below:

How to Download Odisha OTET Result 2026

Candidates must be aware of downloading the OTET Score Card in order to avoid any delay or mistake. To view and download the OTET Result 2026 online, candidates must follow a few simple steps on the BSE Odisha portal. Applicants must ensure that their roll number and login details are ready before starting. Follow the steps to download the OTET merit list below:

  • Step 1: Visit the official website: www.bseodisha.ac.in.
  • Step 2: On the homepage, find and click the “OTET Result 2026” link.

  • Step 3: Enter the OTET roll number or registration details.
  • Step 4: Submit the information to view the result.
  • Step 5: The OTET Result 2026 will be displayed on the screen.
  • Step 6: Download the OTET result 2026 PDF or scorecard for future use and print if needed.

Details Mentioned on the OTET Results PDF 2026

The OTET 2026 results PDF includes essential candidate and exam details that help verify candidates’ performance. It also confirms whether the applicant has qualified the eligibility test, which is the most important factor for future applications. The OTET Result PDF contains the following:

  • Candidate’s Name
  • Roll Number
  • Registration Number
  • Category
  • Marks Secured
  • Qualifying Status
  • Marks in individual subjects / papers

OTET Qualifying Marks 2026

Candidates must secure the minimum marks, which is provided in the OTET exam pattern 2026 as per the respective categories. The qualifying marks differ by category i.e, general candidates require higher marks compared to reserved categories, reflecting official eligibility norms for OTET assessments. Given below are the minimum qualifying marks that are required to be achieved:

Category Qualifying Marks (Out of 150) Minimum %
General 90 60%
OBC / SEBC 75 50%
SC / ST 75 50%
PwD 75 50%

bseodisha.ac.in OTET Scorecard 2026

The OTET Score Card 2026 is released separately after the declaration of the results. It shows marks obtained by individual candidates in Paper I and/or Paper II and indicates whether they have qualified.

  • The scorecard shows total marks and section-wise performance.
  • It includes the qualifying status.
  • The score card is useful for candidates during the recruitment and verification process.

Download and save the OTET scorecard for future teacher recruitment documentation.

OTET Certificate 2026

Qualified candidates in the exam will get digitised OTET certificates from the BSE Odisha website. They will be required to pay the prescribed fee. The date to download the certificate will be available shortly. Candidates should verify all the details printed on it.

What Next After OTET Result 2026

After downloading and checking the OTET 2026 Result, candidates should start preparing for the next steps of their teaching career. Qualifying OTET makes candidates eligible to apply for various teaching posts in primary and upper primary schools across Odisha. Applicants must keep an eye on upcoming recruitment notifications from BSE Odisha and related education bodies. The steps which selected candidates can follow are given below:

  • Apply for Primary & Upper Primary Teacher recruitment
  • Download and print the eligibility certificate
  • Prepare for interviews / document verification
  • Monitor official notifications for job openings

OTET Result 2026 Out: FAQs

Ques: Where can check the BSE Odisha Result 2026?

Answer: Candidates can check OTET Result 2026 on the official website of the Board of Secondary Education, Odisha at bseodisha.ac.in. The result is available online in PDF format.

Ques: What details are required to download BSE Odisha OTET Result ?

Answer: To access the OTET result, candidates need their mobile number and password.

Ques: Is qualifying OTET mandatory for teacher recruitment in Odisha?

Answer: Yes, qualifying the OTET is mandatory in order to become eligible for applying to primary and upper primary teacher posts in government and aided schools in Odisha.

Ques: What is the validity of the OTET qualification certificate?

Answer: The OTET eligibility certificate is generally valid for lifetime, unless revised by the competent authority or BSE Odisha through official notification.

Ques: Does qualifying OTET guarantee a teaching job?

Answer: No, qualifying OTET does not guarantee a job. It only makes candidates eligible to apply for teaching recruitment examinations conducted by various authorities in Odisha.

Answer: The result has been announced on 02 September 2026
